data.narrative:
Cradle is a Series B biotech company that has raised $102.7M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 4 private peers in Biotech & Health at Series B/C stages (Eikon Therapeutics, Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit) and 3 public biotech tickers, anchoring the sector landscape.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $103M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $195M. Peer-median analysis applies the median valuation of the 4 same-sector comparables, which stands at $3.5B, though the peer set spans a wide range from $539M (Eikon Therapeutics) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied—the sector median P/S for biotech is 8.1x across 3 tickers, but Cradle's revenue is not on file. The triangulated valuation range is $166M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Cradle's stage positioning relative to peers and the heterogeneity within the biotech comparables set. The low end reflects funding-based assumptions; the high end reflects peer medians. Revenue disclosure or clearer product-stage clarity would narrow the range substantially.
